name: litigation-workbench
description: Eight business litigation workflows, including deposition source checks, adversarial argument review and a Shepard’s handoff.

interface.longDescription: Build a proof matrix, draft a deposition outline, check an existing outline against the exhibits, reconcile a demand, prepare a Lexis assignment, audit a brief, check case treatment or pressure-test an argument. Works with the sources the attorney supplies. The plugin contains written workflows and adds no external connections.
defaultPrompt: Pressure-test my argument. Show the original, a written steelman, and a fresh adversarial review at xhigh.
Reconcile this demand to the ledger and identify any unsupported payment triggers.
Can I still cite this case for the proposition in my brief? Check later treatment and list what I should Shepardize.
